stepAnswer: The horizontal axis is the sample mean and the vertical axis is probability.
stepTitle: Which titles should be used for the axes of your plot?
stepBody: This problem is unrelated to the previous problem. Suppose you have a box containing prize tickets. Half of the tickets are worth $$0$$ dollars, and other half are worth $$3$$ dollars. Suppose you draw a simple random sample of size $$3$$ with replacement from the box.\nPlot the sampling distribution of the sample mean and provide titles for the axes.
choices: The horizontal axis is probability and the vertical axis is the sample mean.
The horizontal axis is the ticket value and the vertical axis is the count of tickets.
The horizontal axis is the sample mean and the vertical axis is probability.
The horizontal axis is the sample size and the vertical axis is the sample mean.
The horizontal axis is the sample mean and the vertical axis is the number of samples drawn.
